authority: Illustrative classroom workflow only; no bank policy or instructor endorsement is asserted.

REQUEST_INFORMATION.instruction: Prepare missing-information questions for employee review. Do not send to a customer.

PREPARE_BILLING_REVIEW.instruction: Prepare the original complaint, supported summary and missing items for billing-dispute review. Do not decide liability or relief.

PREPARE_SPECIALIST_REVIEW.instruction: Prepare a specialist-review handoff for an employee-selected destination. Do not determine fraud or regulatory status.

MANUAL_REVIEW.instruction: Preserve the original complaint and seek manual assessment; no model result is required.
